SalaryBand.title: Salary band
SalaryBand.description: An internal salary band/scale (min/reference/max gross monthly salary, in integer cents) that compensation-review proposals are checked against (comp-cycles). Bands are the employer's own internal structure, not an external market benchmark (explicitly out of scope). A band MAY reference the maintained CAO corpus by caoId/caoSchaal so its minSalary can be anchored at or above the CAO's statutory minimum maandloon for that scale. Authored reference data: every SalaryBand manifest surface keeps allowCreate:false.

bandId.title: Band id
bandId.description: A short name for the band, for example 'A' or 'schaal-4'.
bandId.x-notes: Stable natural key for the band (e.g. "A", "schaal-4"), distinct from the OpenRegister object id.

title.title: Title
title.description: The band's name, for example 'Schaal A: Junior'.
title.x-notes: Human-readable name of the band (e.g. "Schaal A — Junior").

grade.title: Grade
grade.description: Optional job-grade label the band corresponds to.

minSalary.title: Minimum salary
minSalary.description: Lowest gross monthly salary in this band, in cents.
minSalary.x-notes: Minimum gross monthly salary for this band, in integer cents (the same unit as CompAdjustment.currentSalary/proposedSalary).

referenceSalary.title: Reference salary
referenceSalary.description: The band's reference (midpoint) gross monthly salary, in integer cents. Optional; when present SHOULD sit between minSalary and maxSalary.

maxSalary.title: Maximum salary
maxSalary.description: Maximum gross monthly salary for this band, in integer cents.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: The currency these figures are in, for example EUR.
currency.x-notes: ISO 4217 currency code the band's figures are denominated in.

cao.title: Collective labour agreement
cao.description: The collective agreement this band is anchored to, if any.
cao.x-notes: Optional corpus caoId this band is anchored against (e.g. "cao-generiek") — a plain string link into the CAO corpus, mirroring EmploymentContract.cao, not a $ref relation.

caoSchaal.title: Collective agreement scale
caoSchaal.description: The collective agreement scale this band matches. Only meaningful together with an agreement.
caoSchaal.x-notes: Optional CAO pay-scale key (Cao.payScales) this band corresponds to. Meaningful only alongside cao.

effectiveFrom.title: Effective from
effectiveFrom.description: When this band's figures took effect.
effectiveFrom.x-notes: ISO 8601 date this band's figures took effect.

active.title: Active
active.description: Whether this band is currently in use for new proposals.

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: The steps of this scale, each with its gross monthly salary in cents. An employee moves up one step at each yearly step increase.
steps.x-notes: comp-collective-raise-and-step-increase D5: the employer's own step table (periodieken). Not the CAO corpus, whose per-step tables stay a cao-library non-goal. A step-increase cycle proposes EmploymentContract.salaryStep + 1 at that step's monthlySalaryCents, and never beyond the highest step listed here.

monthlySalaryCents.title: Monthly salary
monthlySalaryCents.description: Gross monthly salary at this step, in cents.

CompReviewCycle.title: Compensation review cycle
CompReviewCycle.description: A periodic compensation-review round (comp-cycles) grouping the per-employee CompAdjustment proposals raised during it. A light open/closed container only: approval happens per adjustment (CompAdjustment carries the draft→proposed→approved→effective lifecycle), so a cycle MAY close while still holding adjustments in any state.

sluiten.description: Close the review round. A closed cycle may still hold adjustments in any state (approval/effectuation is per-adjustment, not per-cycle); closing does not force-effectuate anything. No reopen edge: a closed cycle is history (the ReviewCycle/Objective no-resurrection precedent).

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of this round, for example 'Jaarlijkse beloningsronde 2026'.
name.x-notes: Human-readable name of the review round (e.g. "Jaarlijkse beloningsronde 2026").

period.title: Period
period.description: The period this round covers, for example '2026'.
period.x-notes: Free-text period label the round covers (e.g. "2026").

effectiveDate.title: Effective date
effectiveDate.description: The default date approved changes in this round take effect. An individual change can have its own date.
effectiveDate.x-notes: Default date the round's approved adjustments take effect. Individual CompAdjustments carry their own effectiveDate, which may differ.

status.title: Status
status.description: Whether this cycle is open or closed. Individual adjustments have their own status.
status.x-notes: Governed by the x-openregister-lifecycle state machine (open → closed). Independent of any adjustment's own status.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: What this round does: individual proposals, one raise for everyone in scope, or the yearly step increase.
kind.x-notes: comp-collective-raise-and-step-increase D1/D5. individual: proposals are made one at a time (the comp-cycles MVP). collective: CompCollectiveService proposes raisePercentage or raiseAmountCents for every employee in scope. step-increase: it proposes the next step of the contract's SalaryBand for every contract whose stepDate falls in period.

raisePercentage.title: Raise percentage
raisePercentage.description: For a collective raise: the percentage every salary goes up, for example 2.5.
raisePercentage.x-notes: Applied as round(currentCents x (1 + raisePercentage / 100)) per adjustment, and to EmploymentContract.hourlyWage as proposedHourlyWage. Wins over raiseAmountCents when both are set.

raiseAmountCents.title: Raise amount
raiseAmountCents.description: For a collective raise: a fixed amount in cents added to every monthly salary.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Who a collective raise or step increase covers: an administration, a collective agreement, a team, or any combination.
scope.x-notes: Every key that is set must match (AND). administrationId matches Employee.administrationId; cao matches the covering EmploymentContract.cao; orgUnitId matches an OrgAssignment of the employee that covers the cycle's effectiveDate. An empty scope covers every employee with a contract on the effective date.

cao.title: Collective labour agreement
cao.description: Only contracts under this collective agreement.

orgUnitId.title: Org unit
orgUnitId.description: Only employees placed in this team or department.

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional free-text context for the round.

CompAdjustment.title: Compensation adjustment
CompAdjustment.description: One manager-proposed compensation adjustment for one employee within one CompReviewCycle (comp-cycles), carrying the review-round lifecycle draft → proposed → approved → effective. Separation of duties on approve/reject is enforced by the reused NoSelfApprovalGuard; the approved→effective transition is gated by the read-only, fail-closed CompEffectiveDateGuard. The effective-dated write onto the employee's compensation is a separate imperative step (CompAdjustmentService), never performed by the declarative transition alone.

propose.description: The manager submits the proposed adjustment for approval.

approve.description: A different manager approves the proposal. NoSelfApprovalGuard rejects self-approval (the approver may not be the proposer). An optional decisionReason reaches the employee in the approval notification.

reject.description: The proposal is rejected and returns to draft for revision and re-proposal. NoSelfApprovalGuard rejects self-rejection.

refuse.description: The proposal is refused for good, with a reason the employee receives (comp-collective-raise-and-step-increase D6). Terminal, unlike reject, which sends it back to draft for rework. DecisionReasonGuard refuses an empty decisionReason and, through NoSelfApprovalGuard, a refusal by the proposer.

effectuate.description: The approved adjustment takes effect. CompEffectiveDateGuard fail-closed denies unless effectiveDate is present and on or before today. Read-only guard: the actual grossMonthlySalary write happens imperatively in CompAdjustmentService, not in the guard.

compAdjustmentApproved._note: comp-collective-raise-and-step-increase D7 (REQ-CRS-005): the employee hears the decision. employeeUserId is stamped from Employee.nextcloudUserId by CompCollectiveService, the Payslip.userId denormalisation; an adjustment without it sends nothing. Declarative only, never an imperative dispatch (gate-18, ADR-031).

compAdjustmentRefused._note: comp-collective-raise-and-step-increase D7 (REQ-CRS-005): a refused step or raise reaches the employee with its reason. DecisionReasonGuard makes the reason non-empty before this can fire.

cycleId.title: Review cycle
cycleId.description: The review round this proposal belongs to.
cycleId.x-notes: UUID reference to the CompReviewCycle this proposal belongs to.

employeeId.title: Employee
employeeId.description: Who this pay change is for.
employeeId.x-notes: UUID reference to the Employee this compensation adjustment is proposed for.

contractId.title: Employment contract
contractId.description: The contract this change is tied to. The new salary itself lands on the employee record, which is what payroll reads.
contractId.x-notes: UUID reference to the active EmploymentContract term this change is bound to (audit + eligibility anchor). The effective-dated write itself lands on Employee.grossMonthlySalary — the field the payroll engine reads — not on this contract (verified: EmploymentContract carries only hourlyWage, no monthly-salary field).

currentSalary.title: Current salary
currentSalary.description: The employee's gross monthly salary at the time this was proposed, in cents.
currentSalary.x-notes: Snapshot of the employee's gross monthly salary at proposal time, in integer cents.

proposedSalary.title: Proposed salary
proposedSalary.description: The proposed new gross monthly salary, in integer cents. Checked against targetBandId's [minSalary, maxSalary] by the comp-adjustment-within-band rule.

targetBandId.title: Target band
targetBandId.description: The salary band this proposal is measured against. Leave empty to skip the within-band check.
targetBandId.x-notes: Optional UUID reference to the SalaryBand this proposal is positioned against. The within-band check is vacuous when null (a band-less proposal raises no mandatory violation, the payScalesVerified advisory-until-confirmed precedent).

effectiveDate.title: Effective date
effectiveDate.description: When the change takes effect once approved. It cannot be put into effect before this date.
effectiveDate.x-notes: Date the adjustment takes effect once approved. CompEffectiveDateGuard fail-closed denies effectuate until this date has arrived.

status.title: Status
status.description: Where this adjustment has got to: draft, proposed, approved, then in effect. A refused proposal stays refused.
status.x-notes: Governed by the x-openregister-lifecycle state machine (draft → proposed → approved → effective, or proposed → refused).

proposedBy.title: Proposed by
proposedBy.description: User id of the manager who proposed the adjustment. Drives the NoSelfApprovalGuard separation-of-duties check on approve/reject.

approvedBy.title: Approved by
approvedBy.description: User id of the manager who approved (or rejected) the proposal. Must differ from proposedBy (no self-approval).

rationale.title: Rationale
rationale.x-notes: Free-text motivation for the proposed adjustment.

adjustmentKind.title: Kind of change
adjustmentKind.description: Whether this is an individual change, part of a collective raise, or a yearly step increase.

fromStep.title: From step
fromStep.description: For a step increase: the step the employee is on now.

toStep.title: To step
toStep.description: For a step increase: the step the employee moves to.
toStep.x-notes: Effectuation writes this onto EmploymentContract.salaryStep and moves stepDate one year on (CompAdjustmentService, D4).

proposedHourlyWage.title: Proposed hourly wage
proposedHourlyWage.description: The new hourly wage on the contract, in euros, when the contract has one.
proposedHourlyWage.x-notes: Effectuation writes this onto EmploymentContract.hourlyWage (euros, the unit that field stores). Filled by a percentage raise only.

decisionReason.title: Reason for the decision
decisionReason.description: Why the change was approved or refused. The employee receives it.
decisionReason.x-notes: Required on the refuse transition (DecisionReasonGuard), optional on approve. Rendered into the employee's notification.

employeeUserId.title: Employee account
employeeUserId.description: The employee's Nextcloud account, which receives the decision.
employeeUserId.x-notes: Denormalised copy of Employee.nextcloudUserId, stamped by CompCollectiveService when it creates the proposal (the Payslip.userId precedent). The notification recipient field, and the account NoSelfApprovalGuard compares against so an employee cannot approve their own raise.

appliedAt.title: Applied at
appliedAt.description: When the new salary was actually written onto the employee. Empty until then.
appliedAt.x-notes: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp CompAdjustmentService stamped when it wrote the new grossMonthlySalary onto the Employee and drove the effectuate transition. Null until effectuated.
